description: Return full details for exactly one vault key, looked up by its exact name: provider, status, safe_key, created date, last-used time, and a health/expiry summary. Use this when you already know the key name and need that one key's details; to enumerate all keys, use prophetkey_list_keys instead. Reads local metadata only and never returns the real key value.

name.description: Exact key name as returned by prophetkey_list_keys (case-sensitive).

name: prophetkey_get_key_info
title: Get API key details
